description: This file implements the Widevine platform DRM handler, including constructor, destructor, and decryption methods that interface with the Widevine::Cdm API. It manages handle conversions to secure memory and performs decryption operations.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class that manages Widevine DRM decryption, encapsulating handle conversions and interaction with the Widevine CDM API.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Widevine platform DRM object with a reference to the Widevine CDM.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor that handles cleanup of the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Performs decryption of a batch of samples given a handle, converting it to secure memory and calling the Widevine CDM decrypt method.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Overloaded method that performs decryption given a handle, session ID, and a batch of samples, converting handle to secure memory and calling the Widevine CDM decrypt method.
